acceptance_criteria: All 27,340 source rows are hash-verified and deterministically dispositioned without changing the corrected candidate's six disposition populations.
Every admitted candidate retains exact game, team, season, side, capture, source-row, stat-category, value, and missingness provenance; no source-only or name-only identity is silently promoted.
All 21,168 historical outcome-overlap rows reconcile, including the 18 rows in nine exact-game side swaps, while the side-label conflict remains explicit.

The gate records historical known-at as unknown, admits no pre-capture PIT feature, and cannot be consumed by protected or preliminary chronological replay without a separate eligible timing contract.
Outputs pass identity, schema-drift, missingness, chronology, quarantine, mutation, byte-identical rebuild, Jira, repository, provenance, and full-suite validation before Done.
ai_context_notes: No OpenAI output or generated fact may participate in game/team identity, side reconciliation, statistic values, publication timing, missingness, or validation.
The 2022-2025 same-provider overlap is not independent confirmation and the nine side swaps remain explicit evidence conflicts despite exact point-vector reconciliation.
This unit is a capture-time candidate snapshot prerequisite, not historical PIT, preliminary-model, protected, official-stat, production, or scientific authority.
definition_of_done: Per-season and per-stat-category capture-time snapshot and nonadmitted/quarantine artifacts are immutable, content-addressed, reproducible, and externally stored.
Independent reconstruction verifies source hashes, exact populations, unique natural keys, reconciliation states, schema drift, missingness, capture-time authority, mutations, and byte identity.
Canonical/live Jira, Git/PR evidence, governing goal, active plan, cleanup, and all nonclaims agree before Done.
end_to_end_validation: Re-read the corrected candidate manifest, 261 capture manifests and raw payloads, accepted outcome payload, canonical team evidence, and season payloads; rebuild the snapshot in an isolated external root; verify hashes, populations, natural keys, side swaps, schema drift, missingness, capture-time authority, quarantine, forbidden fields, mutation controls, and byte identity; then remove reconstructible output after validation.
in_scope: Corrected immutable candidate identity 3edf5fe3cf48c9c1000fcbcc1d3fd674ed0875a7e561997f13d3f8d958b01f5b across 2010-2025, 13,670 games, 27,340 team rows, 812,533 stat cells, and 261 exact captures.

Exact game/team identity evidence, cross-route outcome/side reconciliation, season-specific schema and stat-category missingness, explicit 2020 partiality, capture provenance, deterministic replay, and capture-time-only eligibility.
objective: Materialize and independently validate the exact 2010-2025 version-bound team-box candidate as an immutable capture-time historical snapshot while refusing historical PIT backcast or silent promotion of source-only rows and drifting stat categories.
out_of_scope: Historical publication-time inference, pre-capture PIT backcast, same-provider overlap as independent confirmation, zero-filling missing categories, source-only name merges, official-stat promotion, or rewriting immutable source captures.
Protected training/evaluation, champion or production promotion, forecast publication, final historical completeness, A&M lift, BAS, Aggie Excess, or scientific claims.

The complete external population passes source identity, reconstruction, schema, provenance, quarantine, mutation, and byte-identity checks.

risk_failure_conditions: Any source hash, row count, game/team identity, side reconciliation, natural key, stat cell, missingness, schema, capture identity, or rebuild identity drifts.
Any historical publication time, zero-filled missing stat, source-only team merge, outcome/target field, protected decision, or fabricated value enters the snapshot.
scope: Disposition all 27,340 candidate game-team rows, preserve the 21,168 cross-route outcome overlaps and nine side-swap games, materialize only evidence-supported game/team/stat cells, and publish an explicit capture-time eligibility gate with per-season schema and missingness evidence.
stop_conditions: Stop the affected row, game, season, category, or artifact on identity, source, reconciliation, schema, missingness, authority, hash, population, or rebuild failure.
Do not weaken capture-time-only, candidate-only, no-backcast, no-zero-fill, or scientific boundaries merely to obtain approval.
title: [POST-SUBTASK-191] Materialize capture-time team-box snapshot and domain eligibility gate
why_this_exists: Team-box history is the prerequisite candidate layer for player-box and advanced-game-stat reconciliation. The corrected candidate has exact source bytes, two rows for every source game, zero duplicate game/team-side rows, and no unresolved cross-route point conflicts, but its historical publication times remain unknown and therefore require an explicit non-PIT boundary.
